actualDefect.whyItIsWrong: a Work node's label is `${event_type} ${entity_id}`; a display-label substring match is satisfied by a LONGER attempt id that contains this one as a prefix, so the helper can select the wrong node
actualDefect.affectedSurface: the public T0 helper only — buildProjectTrajectory's output and the projection semantic digest are NOT affected by which node this helper returns

reproducer.method: source-text assertion that the substring form is present
reproducer.notDynamicallyReproduced: no product scenario creates two attempt ids where one is a prefix of the other, so the defect is source-demonstrated rather than executed

recommendedMinimalFutureCorrection: compare the exact label `ATTEMPT_CREATED ${attemptId}`, or better, resolve the node by its canonical event identity as the H0 relation selector now does
compatibilityRisks: the exact-label form depends on the label format, which is a presentation choice; resolving by canonicalId is the more durable form
neither form changes the projection output or the semantic digest, so a correction is digest-neutral
whyNotCorrectedInH0: the ruling names src/trajectory/projection.ts as a file not to modify in H0 merely to complete a checklist, and directs a T0 correctness change to its own forward-only slice
verifiedUnmodified: git diff HEAD -- src/trajectory/projection.ts is empty
